encounter: E0175 TRAINER_FOSTER (Route105, Feather Badge - optional Surf backtrack, cap 48, Medium)
availability_audit: Route 105 is reached by Surf after the Balance Badge; the battle index gives this encounter a 48-60 window and 48 is the floor. Every member is gated at 36 or below in work/reference-pools/pool-48.json, so each source map - Granite Cave, the Slateport evolution stock, New Mauville via Wattson's Basement Key, Altering Cave, Sneasel's habitat, the Thwackey line in the Heat Badge window - is entered before the player can Surf to Route 105. No legendaries, no Ultra Beasts, no Paradox species.
plan: Foster is a fossil diver: four Water/Rock/Ground bodies, three of which are 2x or 4x weak to Grass, behind a Shell Smash and a Calm Mind. Rillaboom is the centrepiece - Grassy Glide is priority Grass damage that answers a post-Smash Omastar without needing to outspeed it, and Grassy Surge heals the side. Magnezone's Electric hits every Water, Alakazam's Focus Blast is 2x on both Rock bodies, Weavile and Spiritomb are Dark answers to Mega Slowbro and Runerigus, and Gengar's Taunt is aimed squarely at the SETUP flag: it blanks Shell Smash, Calm Mind, Slack Off and Will-O-Wisp in one move. The named hazard is Runerigus's Wandering Spirit, which swaps abilities with anything that makes contact, so nothing on my side attacks it with a contact move - Rillaboom in particular must never trade Grassy Surge away.
